scientific_integrity: The coefficient identity and asymptotic laws follow from the included analytic proof; the finite computational checker is corroborative only. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact statement is for unweighted simple cycles with standard unnormalized edge roots. Fixed-deletion and positive-density asymptotics are separate; no uniform intermediate transition theorem. Earlier general zonotope intrinsic-volume formula is explicitly credited. An equivalent analytic-combinatoric reformulation in other literature is a residual bibliographic risk.
title: Intrinsic-volume fragmentation of cycle graphical zonotopes: Dirichlet and tilted laws
